results.title: House of Sayuri
results.overview: A family moves into a house, but discover that it is haunted by a murdered girl.

results.title: The Blue Star
results.overview: The 90s. A famous Spanish rock star travels around Latin America in the endeavour to reconnect with his vocation. There he meets an old musician down on his luck, prompting the birth of an unlikely duo with every chance of becoming an epic commercial failure.

results.title: Faceless
results.overview: Kaburagi was arrested as a suspect in a brutal murder case, but he escapes. He continues to hide and move all around Japan. During this time, he meets Sayaka, Kazuya and Mai. Detective Matanuki is on the trail to capture Kaburagi. He interrogates the people who met Kaburagi, but they all describe Kaburagi differently from each other. Kaburagi has been missing for 488 days. Who really is Kaburagi? What is his plan?

results.title: FELIPE
results.overview: The Argentine crisis of 2001 is about to explode. Felipe, 13, sees how his family environment is cracking due to the economic and political pressures. Misunderstood, he falls in love with Lucía, the neighbor next door and for a moment he stops feeling alone. But when external violence becomes a real danger, Felipe escapes with her, fed up with the lies of his parents, leaving behind his innocence.

results.title: MyLek
results.overview: A young single mother struggling to balance her career and personal life navigates a loving but challenging relationship with her strong willed and intrepid teenage daughter as she hits puberty.

results.title: Archeo
results.overview: ARCHEO is a 3D animation film that uses "particles" (thousands of tiny, basic shapes) to construct the target object – a virtual sculpture of Aphrodite.

results.title: Suite Tortilla #60: The New Man and the Schoolteacher
results.original_title: Suite tortilla nro. 60: El hombre y la maestra
results.overview: A documentary vignette explores the life of Revolutionary feminist and filmmaker Magda Gonzalez Grau, capturing a pivotal interview moment that reveals her evolving feminist politics during the Cuban Revolution.

results.title: Immunity
results.overview: Felix and Mark are close to being invited to a party after school. Problem is — they need to bring their own alcohol. With zero experience, they enlist the aid of Ethan, but things don't go as planned, leading Felix and Mark into an argument that puts their friendship hanging in balance.

results.title: Daly City
results.overview: An Indonesian boy and his mother bring Chinese takeout to a church potluck and pretend it’s a traditional family dish. The boy's quiet observations lead him to question his parents' behavior as they strive to find a sense of belonging in a new country.

results.title: Lilacs
results.overview: Katarina and Igor are actors who are together both on and off the screen. Blinded by flashes and deafened by applause, they, although inseparable, did not hear or see each other in a long time, until the award ceremony for the best series of the year, where the whole team will gather. There, everything will be revealed - the good, the bad and the ugly of the film and TV industry in Serbia today. It will become clear that their lives are a bigger melodrama than the one they acted in.

results.title: Quick Buck
results.overview: When a thief lifts his brother's wallet off of him, local go-getter Sam chases the crook across town on his stuck-up brother's behalf to garner praise and acceptance from him.

results.title: The Little Other
results.overview: Two children are waiting to be born. One is an ordinary child, the other a trickster. How do we know which one is which? No one knows what will happen - the old rules are being torn down while the new ones have not been established yet.

results.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
results.overview: Follows a special that describes an openly glamorous and sexual exploration of womanhood in one's 30s, with a blend of stand-up comedy and cabaret.

results.title: Séance Games: Metaxu
results.overview: Social media stars unite to play METAXU, an online séance game, only to find they have unwittingly unleashed the Gates of Hell.

results.title: Qalb
results.overview: Qalb tells the story of two young hearts falling in love. The ride takes you through the 7 stages of love. The title song 'Qalbee' describes the spiritual elements of love. Like faith there is no compulsion in love either.

results.title: The Best
results.overview: Powerful waves of grief threaten to shatter the confidence of a South Asian bodybuilder in this bold and insightful character study by director Ian Bawa.

results.title: 200KG Vampire
results.overview: The residents of Kampung Terbalik become victims of attacks by Pontianak Melati and Pontianak Mewangi, who are constantly hungry. The situation becomes even more chaotic when the villagers mistakenly believe that they are blood-sucking pontianaks, causing many villagers to fall into comas!

results.title: Las cucarachas
results.overview: Sofía has inherited a bar from her parents, in the neighborhood where she grew up.  One night , after finishing her shift , she finds Manuel, an old friend of her parents and one of her regular customers, lying on the ground after being assaulted.

results.title: Balas & Bolinhos: Só Mais Uma Coisa
results.original_title: Balas & Bolinhos: Só Mais Uma Coisa
results.overview: The final chapter of the Balas & Bolinhos saga.
